guideNotes: For most items, if you have them in excess or your stash is almost full, then the ideal option would be to sell unless you need it for a certain quest.
If you are Topside for at least 1 minute, Scrappy will accumulate Metal Parts, Fabric, Plastic Parts, Chemicals, Rubber Parts, and Assorted Seeds
based on time spent and whether you successfully extract.
He does not work while you are offline or hanging out in Speranza.
So, remember to use Scrappy for accumulating basic materials and seeds
strategically which will allow you to bring in more expensive and rare items to Speranza.
Inventory Management Tip (if you're running out of space):
An important tip for maintaining space in your inventory is by not hoarding up on locked door keys and keeping ammo in your stash
As soon as you get a key during a round, try to use it in your next round, because these keys do not stack unlike other items.
Additionally, try to craft bullets before you deploy so your stash has some free space which can remain occupied if you store too much ammo.
ARC Raiders Wiki loot table for extra reference in-case I don't update this in time
